unknowns: indoor airflow (Débit d'air) cooling and heating: published as '-' (dash) in preliminary blue cells; NOT extracted
indoor filter type: published as '-' (dash); not extracted
indoor sound power heating: published as '-' (dash); only cooling sound power (60 dBA) published
indoor electrical supply/voltage: not published for indoor unit (supply shown at outdoor unit)
indoor fan motor output / fan electrical input: not published
capacityClass: no published kW class scalar; '50' is a model size code
SEER 7,33 / SCOP 4,6 / Pdesign / EER / COP / annual kWh / energy-label A++ are system (50AW/S/B + 50A) ratings, not indoor-unit facts

sound pressure row 'Silence/Bas/Haut' publishes 4 slash values (cooling 46/39/31/24*, heating 46/42/33/24*) under 3 labels; exact cell-to-label mapping ambiguous; values recorded in published order; asterisk = +2 dBA in Multi configuration
colour suffix AW/AS/AB are distinct references (white/silver/black); grouped as one 50AW/S/B column, not split into separate files this batch
page footnote: blue cells = preliminary data; airflow/filter/electrical-input/heating-sound-power cells are blue -> treated as unpublished/unknown
current 2026 availability of FTXJ-AW/S/B: unknown; dated historical coverage
